ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the image is a eukaryotic cell labeled Eukaryote, and on the right side is a prokaryotic cell labeled Prokaryote. The prokaryotic cell on the right has a long and curved tail-like structure extending to the right, and the arrow label in the image points to it and is labeled “Flagellum”. Reasoning: The question asks what the “long whip-like object that helps the cell get where it needs to go” is. The label of this long whip-like tail structure in the image is Flagellum, so the answer is flagellum.
